prompt: Which statements correctly compare github.dev and a codespace? Choose all that apply.
explanation: github.dev is free light editing in the browser — no execution, no codespace billing. A codespace is the executing environment, and it opens from the browser or your editor alike.

options.text: github.dev opens with the `.` key on any repository
github.dev cannot run your code or a terminal
A codespace can build, run, and debug the project
github.dev requires a paid Codespaces plan
A codespace cannot be opened in a browser
